title: 💸 A $169 Million Governor's Race
text: Byron Donalds' campaign and Friends of Byron Donalds committee have raised about $168.8M through Oct 25, the most in Florida history, against roughly $26M for David Jolly. Jolly publicly told national Democrats "I'm begging for help"; the DGA added $1M on Oct 20. (FL Division of Elections via Sparkers Soapbox; Florida Politics; Florida Phoenix)

title: 🏛️ Cabinet Money Gaps vs. Toss-Up Polls
text: Blaise Ingoglia has outspent Annette Taddeo roughly 9-to-1 ($14.0M vs $814k) yet four polls show the CFO race tied or within 2 points. Wilton Simpson's committees hold $22M in cash against Joey Atkins' $91k, a roughly 500-to-1 edge. (FL Division of Elections through Oct 25; Florida Politics)

title: ⚡ Utility Money in the St. Pete Mayor's Race
text: Charlie Crist's St. Pete Shines committee has topped $2.1M; the Tampa Bay Times, Axios and Florida Trib traced donations through chains of PACs to Duke Energy, TECO and FPL-parent interests while the city weighs its Duke franchise. Ken Welch's committee raised nothing after Sept 30 and he entered mid-October with about $21k cash.
